{{Top|leg}}
The '''torture wheel''' was a gyroscopic device used to detain [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. It was designed to contain one person. As a [[Torture/Legends|torture]] device, it was designed with little regard for the comfort of its inmates and was capable of rotating in a way that would cause discomfort to the inmate. It could also be transported by rolling its main chassis.

In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]] was held in one of these devices during his incarceration in the [[Daimanate]].
